propagator_readback.note: read from prop.GetPropagator() after PrepareInternals(), not the front-end Propagator or the bare integrator object -- see this script's module doc

reason: N1 (docs/native-dynamics-plan.md): the same arc as leo_1day_jgm2_8x8_sunmoon.json (same epoch, same initial Keplerian elements, same ballistic set) with the third bodies (Sun, Moon; N2 scope) removed and no drag/SRP/relativity/tides added, so N1's EarthGravityModel (point-mass/spherical-harmonic gravity only) has a golden to pin against without a force outside its own scope. Regenerated by the native-dynamics manager (round 1 review) for one reason only: the tolerance first recorded here was gen_leo_1day.py's inherited 0.05 m default, which pinned nothing, while crates/av-orbital/tests/gravity_goldens.rs held the native model to the MEASURED 6e-3 m. ADR-002's goldens rule requires the tolerance committed with the golden to be the tolerance in force, so it is now the measured one: the native EarthGravityModel (JGM2 8x8, GMAT-validated body-fixed rotation, Dopri5 rtol=atol=1e-12) reproduces this arc's final state to 4.557868e-3 m and 5.050580e-6 m/s over 86400 s, 0.8x the P0 spike's 5.7 mm/day integrator-only reference; the native acceleration agrees with GMAT's own GetDerivatives to 3.97e-15 m/s^2 (4.70e-16 relative) over four epochs, so the residual is integrator-family disagreement, not a force-model difference. The GMAT-side state is unchanged by this regeneration.
